description: Blocked region → notify-me form → confirmation. Requires Illinois GPS mock before launch.
pre_run_note: Set Illinois coordinates BEFORE launching app: xcrun simctl location set <UDID> 41.8781 -87.6298

steps.note: App boot — has_seen_welcome_v1 already set for this run; goes straight to ComplianceGuard
GPS + geocode resolves to IL → blockedRegion status
Blocked: amber card, region name, Notify me CTA
Tap 'Notify me when available' → shows email field
State C: envelope pulse, 'We'll email you' confirmation (300ms crossfade)
